### 🌐 Independent Consortia / Voluntary Chains

Beyond the major chains, European owners also commonly consider membership-based consortia, which offer distribution and marketing benefits without a full franchise relationship:

citations.cited_text: Marketing collections that group independently owned hotels under one name, one benefits program and one set of standards, rather than one owner: Lead...
citations.title: Soft-Brand Hotel Collections and Consortia | Luxury Hotels Ranked

content.text: These include **Leading Hotels of the World**, **Relais & Châteaux**, **Small Luxury Hotels of the World**, **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, **Design Hotels**, and **Historic Hotels Worldwide**.

citations.cited_text: Mechanism: A major chain (e.g., Hilton) signs an exclusive distribution agreement with a boutique collection (e.g., SLH). The boutique hotels appear o...
citations.title: Should Your Independent Hotel Join a Soft Brand Collection? - White Sky Hotel Consultancy & Training

content.text: Under hybrid partnership models, a major chain (e.g., Hilton) signs an exclusive distribution agreement with a boutique collection (e.g., SLH), where boutique hotels appear on the major chain's website and offer loyalty points but remain legally contracted to the boutique collection — not the major chain. Similar examples include Hyatt's acquisition of Mr & Mrs Smith.
